acceptance: A fixture lane on a red base with a green main rebases and is not blamed
A fixture lane on a red base with a red main parks with its continuation and the loop emits main-red
A fix lands while the stop holds and the stop then releases
Past the bound the stop escalates with its cause and resume condition
fix: When a gate rejects a lane (build floor repo-contract checks, audit CI-parity, ship), rerun the red tests on the lane base. Red on base and green main: rebase the lane onto main and rerun. Red on base and red main: park the lane with its continuation and signal main-red. While main is red, both landing paths land only a fix (turns a red gate green, none red). A policy bound (default 120 minutes) escalates through ADR-0155. Design review before build.
summary: Component G4 of docs/plans/gate-contract-2026-11.md (ADR-0165 decisions 10-14; spec section 4). On 2026-11-09 cycles 2240, 2242 and 2249 failed on a red that their base held, 513 LLM minutes; 333 of them at the build floor of 2242. Main was red for hours with no loop signal.
title: Gate contract G4: base-red attribution at build, audit and ship, and a main-red stop
